Questions and answers

What is Informe de Presión Barométrica?

In this glossary, Informe de Presión Barométrica refers to: Regularly transmitted statement of current atmospheric pressure and trend for meteorological data exchange and storm tracking.

How is Informe de Presión Barométrica used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Buque de investigación Polaris a red meteorológica: informe de presión barométrica 1002 hectopascales, descenso de tres en la última hora, cambio."

Definition

Regularly transmitted statement of current atmospheric pressure and trend for meteorological data exchange and storm tracking.

Operational example

Research vessel Polaris to weather network: barometric pressure report 1002 hectopascals, falling three in last hour, over.

Localized term

Informe de Presión Barométrica

Localized example
